Contiguous MoE: quant→dispatch→group/replicate→two GEMMs with activation/quant→unpermute→top-k weighting/reduction→combine. M_dp, dispatched M and replicated M_dash differ; backend schematic not GLM measured path.
Batched MoE: expert-major padded/masked tensor, batched GEMM, combine also weights/reduces. Diagram max_tokens256 is this backend example and must not become global/Ascend default.
Prepare quantizes/dispatches; optional finalize performs weights/reduce; final combine. Composition boundary differs by implementation.
FusedExperts groups permute/GEMMs/activation/quant/unpermute; weighted reduction may be inside or outside block. Not proof all implementations fuse each operation.
Compile pipeline separates graph capture, split attention boundary, Inductor/custom-pass artifacts and CUDA graph wrappers; CUDA example not Ascend capture evidence.
tlparse example points from compilation event artifacts to emitted Inductor/Triton code; screenshot is debugging navigation, not a reproduced profile.
Dynamic branch shape%128 creates guard; example tlparse guard stack and cache miss files explain specialization. Does not prove arbitrary dynamic shape reuse.
Metrics normal timeline: API arrival→iteration defines frontend TTFT; EngineCore queue/scheduled/token timestamps delimit scheduler/inference spans. Not device kernel time.
Decode preemption lies inside elapsed decode/ITL interval; waiting after preemption is not automatically subtracted.

Prefill preemption lies inside prefill/TTFT. Its drawn inference bracket starts at first token whereas normal figure starts at scheduled: do not copy inconsistent bracket as a definition; use fixed stats consumer.
Historical CUDA Q layout divides head128 by vec4 into32 vectors. Generic block explanation remains separate from kernel thread layout.
Two-thread Q group alternates vec0/2 and1/3, sixteen vectors each for illustrative head128.
K context layout assigns warp to cache blocks and group to token; feature vectors interleaved over group threads.
K thread0 takes even-numbered vectors; full QK result still needs group reduction.
V layout uses vectors across tokens and head-row iteration; v_vec224 is vector number, not head position224.
Logits vector covers eight token weights; paired with eight values for same head row.
Thread0 V rows are head0,16,...112 with vec0,32,...224. Mother prose says acc head0,32,...224 and is inconsistent with its own image; preserve actual distinction, do not teach this typo.
